note: China's provincial licence ceiling for 腹腔内窥镜手术系统 under 大型医用设备配置许可. Rules. (1) This system has NO brand, model, manufacturer or price field anywhere in it, so it can state a denominator and can never state a market share; every caveat must say so. (2) Three numbers must never be conflated and each needs its own source: licences PERMITTED (the national and provincial quota), licences AWARDED (published province by province, never consolidated), and machines INSTALLED (for which no official figure exists at all). (3) The 14th Five-Year Plan quota expired 2025-12-31 and no successor had been published as of 2026-09-21, so any use of it must be date-stamped as lapsed. (4) Only laparoscopic systems are covered; orthopaedic, neurosurgical, vascular and bronchoscopy robots sit outside the regime and have no quota data at all.
